name: B10-0139/2024 (Renew) – Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks Azerbaijan to release people held for their political views, to treat prisoners humanely, and to let doctor Gubad Ibadoghlu get treatment abroad. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Azerbaijani officials and to make any future partnership with Azerbaijan depend on releasing political prisoners and improving human rights. It also calls for a peace treaty between Azerbaijan and Armenia.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only asks the European Union to consider sanctions and to set conditions on any future partnership with Azerbaijan.
- The people affected are political prisoners, activists, journalists and prisoners of war, plus Azerbaijani officials who could face sanctions.
- Next, the requests go to the European Union's Council, Commission and foreign policy chief, and to the governments of Azerbaijan and Armenia.
